title: Wolves Circling
next_chapter_hook: The moment the envoy from the Imperial Dynasty stepped into the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that face bore an unmistakable resemblance to the Chen Family branch emblem recorded on the Tianji Record's ten-thousand-year-old list.

text.content: Those lines of ink seemed to writhe like living creatures on the paper's surface. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center as the characters on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly enlarged, and an ancient, primordial aura rushed toward him—'Beneath the Heavenly Dao, there are other Chess Players.' He didn't move, even holding his breath to three-quarters of normal. Mr. Mo had said the Tianji Record never speaks without purpose. This sixth character—was it a warning, or perhaps... a guide?

dialogue.content: (The voice of the Residual Soul Guardian echoed from deep within the Tianji Record, carrying a rare gravity) This thirteenth page... even this old one has never seen it. It seems the artifact spirit has finally decided to show you what it has been hiding.

text.content: The moment the Tianji Record unsealed itself, the spiritual energy within the entire Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate suddenly became chaotic. The steward guarding the Scripture Repository abruptly looked up, only to see invisible waves rippling across the distant horizon—like a massive stone dropped into water, the ripples spreading in all directions. Wherever that wave passed, every artifact related to the word 'destiny' let out a piercing alarm cry.

At the same moment, deep within the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, an ancient mirror sealed in mystic ice suddenly shattered. As ice shards flew, the mirror's surface reflected a vague human silhouette. Ling Yuan's eyes snapped open, and a barely containable greed flickered across his turbid old eyes—the Heavenly Secrets fluctuation, missing for three years, had finally reappeared.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's withered fingers twirled Buddhist beads, his voice cold as the Nine Netherworld winds) Pass the order—seal all exits of the mountain gate. Also dispatch secret guards to monitor the servants' area. That surname-Chen小子... this old one always feels something is off.

text.content: Meanwhile, thousands of miles away in the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds, on a battle arena forged from ten thousand jin of mystic iron, Han Lie was locked in a life-and-death struggle with a third-tier demon beast. Suddenly, his brow center stung with pain, and his battle halberd nearly slipped from his grasp. From the sect's communication pavilion in the distance, a spiritual light broke through the air—he caught it in one hand: Heavenly Secrets fluctuation anomaly, source pointing toward the Tianqing Sect direction.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie abruptly sheathed his halberd, the demon beast took the chance to flee, but he didn't care at all, a bloodthirsty smile curling his lips) Tianqing Sect? That place where that废物 stays? Interesting, this young lord wants to see what kind of装神弄鬼 is going on this time!

text.content: In the central command tent of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing dressed in black纱 was gazing at the Destiny Compass before her. Suddenly, the compass needle spun wildly, and the demon mark on her brow center lit up—an inexplicable emotion came from the distant Central Plains direction, that feeling... as if the gears of destiny had been forcibly turned. She closed her eyes, sensing that familiar aura.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing flicked her delicate hand, the demonic mist stirred quietly, her voice low as if talking to herself) He indeed encountered trouble... Mr. Mo was right, the variables on this kid outweigh the entire battlefield combined. Pass the order—pull back the army thirty li, avoid the Tianqing Sect direction.

choice.prompt: The anomaly of the Tianji Record attracted the attention of forces in all directions. Chen Ji had to make a response. He knew the principle of 'the loudest nail gets hammered first,' and what mattered most now was—

choices.description: Immediately appear publicly with the 'useless person' persona, making everyone believe the Heavenly Secrets fluctuation has nothing to do with him
choices.visible_reward: Buying Three Days of Buffer Time
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's Secret Guards Have Already Set Their Sights on You

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve. He deliberately stumbled out of his room, knocked over a water bucket in the corridor, and狼狈地 crouched down to pick it up—this act, he had performed for three years, it was already flawless. The secret guard secretly observing from afar slightly frowned: Is this that废物? The Heavenly Secrets fluctuation should have nothing to do with him.

choices.description: Deliberately leak part of the Heavenly Secrets fluctuation's location to Han Lie, provoking the Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect to fight each other
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Grudge with Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: The Two Great Sects Constrain Each Other
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie Might See Through the Framing Scheme

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he took out a blank talisman paper and sketched out false coordinates of the Heavenly Secrets fluctuation with spiritual energy. He handed the talisman paper to a spirit crane, destination—the Xuanwu Sect. The talisman paper would be 'accidentally' intercepted by Han Lie in two days. At that time, this Xuanwu genius would definitely charge toward the Tianqing Sect at the first moment.

choices.description: Using the Demonic Path mist to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, borrowing Ye Qing's power to temporarily hide
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the protection of Demonic Path mist
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Saintess must have ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji bit through his fingertip, using blood as ink to quickly draw a secret rune on the talisman paper—this was the emergency communication talisman Ye Qing had given him. The talisman turned into a wisp of black smoke and dissipated into the void. He closed his eyes and waited. After ten breaths, a gentle Demonic Path mist seeped in through the window, shrouding his entire body. The aura of the Tianji fluctuations instantly became elusive and unpredictable.

However, just as various forces churned beneath the surface, a melodious horn resounded beyond the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. It was neither a war drum nor a funeral bell—but the imperial court's exclusive 'ceremonial music for welcoming guests.' Three horn blasts signified an imperial decree, requiring the sect to open its main gates and receive with the highest honors. Ling Yuan's expression shifted abruptly. Why would the imperial court arrive at this moment?

The mountain gate slowly opened, and a team of imperial guards in dark armor entered first, their hawk-like gazes sweeping over everyone present. Then, an ornate palanquin carried by eight men descended gracefully from the clouds. The curtain was lifted, revealing a long, pale hand reaching out first, followed by a face wearing a silver mask. After stepping down, the figure's gaze swept across the crowd before finally fixing on the servant disciples' area.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's heart lurched violently—the gaze seemed capable of piercing through his disguise and reaching the deepest depths of his soul. He forced himself to maintain a humble posture, but within his sleeve, he secretly gripped the Tianji Record—this imperial emissary was by no means ordinary.)

text.content: Ling Yuan personally went out to greet, but the person in the palanquin merely nodded slightly, then produced a bright yellow imperial edict, announcing in a clear voice: 'By the mandate of Heaven, the Emperor decrees—the recent anomalous fluctuations of Heavenly Secrets at Tianqing Sect have greatly worried the Imperial Lord. An imperial envoy is hereby dispatched to investigate, and there is another matter that requires a face-to-face discussion with a certain servant disciple of your esteemed sect.' He paused, his gaze sweeping toward the servant area once more. 'This person's name is—Chen Ji.'

The moment these words fell, the entire assembly erupted. The imperial envoy had come personally, merely to find a servant disciple? Ling Yuan's pupils contracted slightly as he calculated rapidly: what exactly was Chen Ji's background? And hidden within the crowd, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill—how could the imperial court know his name? More importantly, the tone in the envoy's voice clearly carried a hint of... familiarity?

choice.prompt: The imperial envoy publicly named his target, and the situation took a sharp turn for the worse. Ling Yuan's gaze had already turned scrutinizing, Han Lie's spies were watching from the shadows, and Chen Ji had to make an immediate decision—

choices.description: Actively walk out from the crowd, facing the envoy in his '废物' posture to probe the enemy's hand
choices.visible_cost: Completely exposing himself under Ling Yuan's watchful eye
choices.visible_reward: Gaining an opportunity for direct dialogue with the imperial court
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might be making moves in the shadows

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji took a deep breath, stumbling out from the crowd, his face wearing perfectly calibrated panic) This commoner Chen Ji, prostrating before the esteemed envoy. I am unaware why Your Grace has summoned me... I... I am truly terrified and anxious.(He kept his head bowed, but his peripheral vision locked死死 onto every subtle movement of the envoy)

text.content: The envoy glanced down at him, and a meaningful chuckle emerged from behind the silver mask: 'Indeed, an interesting person.' He suddenly lowered his voice, speaking in a volume only the two of them could hear, 'The branch of the Chen family from the ten-thousand-year-old list—this seat has waited for this day... far too long.'

choices.description: Secretly detonate a talisman to create chaos, retreating into the shadows while observing the situation

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip stirred with spiritual energy, and a hidden explosive talisman in his sleeve activated silently. The next moment, a deafening explosion rang out from a corner of the servant area, followed by billowing smoke. The crowd immediately descended into chaos, imperial guards drew their blades, and Ling Yuan barked orders to capture the assassins. Chen Ji seized the opportunity to retreat into the shadows, only to find that the envoy remained utterly unmoved, as if he had anticipated this move.

choices.description: Immediately activate the Demonic Path mist, preventing the Angel from temporarily locking onto his position
choices.visible_cost: Exhausting the trust with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: The Angel may see through Demonic Path techniques

text.content: Chen Ji moved with a thought, and the Demonic Path mist talisman in his sleeve activated abruptly. A thin layer of black mist spread from beneath his feet, enveloping his entire form. However, the Angel seemed capable of seeing through all illusions, his gaze precisely piercing the mist to fall upon Chen Ji's hidden location. "Interesting." he said softly, "The secret techniques of the Holy Sect's Demonic Path... You certainly have wide connections."

Just then, Ling Yuan suddenly stepped forward, clasped his hands and said: "Angel大人, this Chen Ji is merely a Servant Disciple of our sect, of humble status. How could he possibly deserve a summons by imperial decree? Is there perhaps some misunderstanding?" His tone was respectful, but his eyes secretly surged with killing intent—regardless, this variable must not fall into the hands of the imperial court! The secrets of the Tianji Record must belong to the Tianqing Sect!

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's sleeve surged with hidden force, an invisible restriction silently spreading toward Chen Ji's location. However, the Angel merely raised his hand lightly, dissolving the restriction into nothingness) Ling Gate Master need not be tense. This one comes only to deliver a message, not to recruit personnel. As for whether this young friend Chen wishes to leave with this one... (he looked at Chen Ji) That depends on his own choice.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the shadows, the Demonic Path mist swirling around him unceasingly. He stared directly at that silver mask, countless thoughts churning in his heart—list from ten thousand years ago, Chen Family branch, these words exploded like thunder in his mind. His origins were far more complex than he himself had imagined. And this imperial court Angel,究竟是敌是友?

choice.prompt: Encircled on all sides, wolves circling around. Chen Ji must find a path of survival among the three forces of the imperial court, the sect, and the Demonic Path—his choice will determine the direction of fate to come:

choices.description: Enter the game personally, investigate the origins between the imperial court and the Chen Family, while leaving this place of turmoil
choices.visible_cost: Leave the protection of the Tianqing Sect
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence regarding his origins
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will never let this go

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji straightened his clothes, bowed to Ling Yuan with neither humility nor arrogance) Sect Master forgives, but summoned by the Angel, this humble one dares not refuse. (He stepped toward the palanquin, yet his peripheral vision caught Su Qingyao in the crowd's corner, gazing at him with complex eyes—those eyes held confusion, inquiry, and a trace of... worry?)

choices.description: Refuse to go with the Angel immediately, use "sect disciple" identity as pretext to争取留在天青宗
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will seize the opportunity to make a move

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, clasped his hands toward the Angel) Angel大人permits this humble one to speak: though humble, this one is also a Servant Disciple registered with the Tianqing Sect. Sect rules require Sect Master's approval for disciples to leave the sect. This humble one dares not disobey the Angel, but also asks the Angel to understand this humble one's predicament. (These words were watertight, giving the Angel face while binding Chen Ji to the Tianqing Sect, leaving Ling Yuan momentarily unable to find a reason to act)

choices.description: Publicly propose conditions: the imperial court must offer sufficient compensation before he considers cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Test the imperial court's bottom line
choices.risk_hint: The celestial messenger might sweep their sleeves and depart.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile blazing sharply beneath the mask of humility) The celestial messenger said the lowly one may choose personally, so the lowly one shall choose—what other bargaining chips has the Imperial Court prepared, besides delivering messages? After all... (he lowered his voice) something that could prompt the celestial messenger to make a personal visit surely wouldn't come cheap.

text.content: At these words, Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply—how dare this这小子 negotiate with the Imperial Court? Yet the celestial messenger let out a low, resonant laughter from behind the silver mask, as if hearing some hilarious joke: "Truly a member of the Chen family, that stubborn streak of refusing to yield until seeing one's coffin, utterly unchanged." He drew from his sleeve an ancient, plain jade pendant, "Will this suffice as a bargaining chip?"

The jade pendant glowed pure white throughout, its surface carved with an ancient rune—Chen Ji's breath instantly froze. That rune was identical to the mark on the cover of the Tianji Record, unmistakably the seal of the same lineage. The celestial messenger cradled the pendant in his palm, his tone unhurried: "This is an artifact preserved by the Imperial Court for ten thousand years, originating from... your ancestor, Chen Xuan." These words struck like thunder, and Chen Ji finally understood why the Tianji Record had chosen him—all of this, from the very beginning, was a game spanning ten thousand years.

Wolves circled around, clouds stirred in all directions. The Imperial Court's celestial messenger's jade pendant hung suspended in mid-air, Ling Yuan's killing intent prickled like芒刺背, Han Lie's spies lurked in concealment watching, while Ye Qing far among the demonic army's mists sensed the unusual fluctuation here through the demonic path's fog. Within the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, undercurrents surged violently—everyone waited for that "废物" servant disciple to make one of the most crucial choices in his life. And just then, deep within the Tianji Record, the characters on the thirteenth page suddenly glowed faintly: "Beneath heavenly principles, there are other chess players—and you shall become the new chess player, or be crushed as a chess piece by the chess players."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze penetrating through the crowd, through the palanquin, through that jade pendant, as if seeing an even more distant future. He murmured to himself, voice so low only he could hear) Ancestor Chen Xuan... the first inheritor of the Tianji Record. The roster from ten thousand years ago, the chess game ten thousand years later. So from beginning to end, I was never accidentally swept into this chaotic game—but rather... destined by fate. (A curve formed at the corner of his lips, containing bitterness, release, and an indescribable sharp edge) Since it is so, then let me see what other secrets lie hidden "beneath the heavenly principles."
